Tyāga
vedic. no. of homas to be offered to deities acc. to Ṛv. sūktas. RASB. II. 250 (III).

Tyāgarāja
famous Carnatic musician an. composer (1758-1846 A. D.); born a. Tiruvārūr a. the son of Rāmabrahman; spent most of his life a. Tiruvāḍi; a. of many songs in Telugu an. a few in Skt.
See Spiritual Heritage of Tyāgarāja Madras, 1957.

Tyāgarāja
or Kāśyapagotra, grandfather of Gururāmakavi (a. of Ratneśvaraprasādana, etc.). See NCC. VI. p. 80a.

Tyāgarāja
